findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: fetch, compare_tools, list_alternatives, list_scenarios, whats_new · Private data: log_choice · Public sink: subscribe, save_preferences · Destructive: forget_me.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: fetch, compare_tools, list_alternatives, list_scenarios, whats_new · Private data: log_choice · Public sink: subscribe, save_preferences · Destructive: forget_me

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
